summary: Phase 2 ItineraryHubPage inline CMS verified end-to-end on /viajes/marrakech_ergchebbi_marrakech (and spot-checked on /viajes/gransur/fez-rak). NORMAL mode renders hero/intro/options/community without crashes; H1 = 'Marrakech – Erg Chebbi – Marrakech.', 6 hub-program cards, intro overline, options overline and community band all show real localized text. Toggling header-text-edit-toggle exposes 63 inline-editable surfaces on the Marrakech hub (and 70 on the gransur hub) — well above the 'dozens' bar — split as 20 per-page content slots + 24 global hub-ui labels + duplicates (cta_card per card, nights per card). Per-page CONTENT save (viajes.marrakech_ergchebbi_marrakech.hero.title) and GLOBAL label save (hub-ui.cta_primary) both PUT /api/text_slots/<slot> => 200 and survive a hard reload (verified visually after reload — hero showed ' [E2E-P2]' appended and CTA showed 'VER OPCIONES *'). Direct API GET /api/text_slots also confirmed persisted values. Regression with text edit OFF: hub-program cards navigate correctly (e.g. /viajes/marrakech_ergchebbi_marrakech/programa_2n_3d), opposite-hub toggle data-testid is rendered only when hub.oppositeHub is configured (null on these two hubs — not a regression, just data). Edits were CLEANED UP after testing (both touched slots reset to {} via PUT).
critical_code_review_comments: ItineraryHubPage.jsx (300 LOC) is clean and well-factored; the <L>/<C>/<G> helpers mirror ProgramTemplate's pattern, which keeps mental load low.

Slot naming is correct and predictable: per-page = '<dotted-path>.<name>' with an extra SlotScope for the OptionsGrid (e.g. viajes.marrakech_ergchebbi_marrakech.hub.marrakech-loop.options.overline). This is fine but worth documenting in a /lib/slots.md if not already.

hub-ui.cta_card is rendered once per program card, so the data-testid repeats (we found it 6 times on the Marrakech hub). React works because it's not a key, but if a future Playwright selector does query_selector_all on '[data-testid=editable-text-hub-ui.cta_card]', it returns duplicates. Consider uniqueifying via the SlotScope (hub-ui.cta_card.<program_id>) OR keep current shared behaviour intentionally (label is the same for all).
Same observation for hub-ui.nights.<n>: shared global label intentionally repeats per card — currently fine.
EditableImage and EditableText share the same fetch-once-then-subscribe pattern (cache module-singleton). PUT updates the local cache and notifies subscribers — good, no stale UI on the same tab.
No oppositeHub on the two hubs I tested. The toggle JSX is correctly conditional on hub.oppositeHub, so it does NOT render an empty button. Verified no broken anchors in NORMAL mode.
test_credentials: N/A — text edit toggle is public via header data-testid='header-text-edit-toggle'.
seed_data_creation: During the run two slots were written and then RESET back to empty values to honour the 'keep edits minimal' note. Slots touched (now empty): viajes.marrakech_ergchebbi_marrakech.hero.title, hub-ui.cta_primary.
